# gitea_push_mirror (Resource)

`gitea_push_mirror` manages a repository push mirror in Gitea.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gitea_user" "example" {
  username   = "mirror_example_user"
  login_name = "mirror_example_user"
  password   = "Geheim1!"
  email      = "mirror_example_user@user.dev"
}

resource "gitea_repository" "example" {
  username = gitea_user.example.username
  name     = "push-mirror-example-repo"
  private  = true
}

resource "gitea_push_mirror" "example" {
  owner           = gitea_user.example.username
  repo            = gitea_repository.example.name
  remote_address  = "https://github.com/example/target-repo.git"
  remote_username = "gituser"
  remote_password = "supersecretpassword"
  interval        = "8h0m0s"
  sync_on_commit  = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `owner` (String) The owner (user or organization) of the repository.
- `remote_address` (String) The remote repository URL to push to.
- `repo` (String) The name of the repository.

### Optional

- `interval` (String) Interval between mirror syncs (e.g. `8h0m0s`).
- `remote_password` (String, Sensitive) Password or authentication token for the remote repository.
- `remote_username` (String) Username for authenticating with the remote repository.
- `sync_on_commit` (Boolean) Whether to trigger mirror sync when new commits are pushed.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Timestamp when the push mirror was created.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `last_error` (String) Last error message recorded during sync, if any.
- `last_update` (String) Timestamp of the last sync update.
- `remote_name` (String) The remote name assigned to the push mirror by Gitea.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import gitea_push_mirror.example owner:repo:remote_name
```
